name: AnimagiC
blurb: A long-running anime, manga and Japan convention in Mannheim with Japanese and German guests of honor, music acts and an anime film festival.

editions.evidence: Homepage: '30. Juli – 1. August 2027 · Rosengarten · Mannheim' and 'Auch bei der 27. Convention-Ausgabe erwartet euch...'.

notes: This will be the 27th edition. Guest-of-honor navigation only lists past years (2017-2026) and the site states 'Erste Ankündigungen für 2027 folgen demnächst' (first 2027 announcements coming soon), confirmed by direct page fetch, so guests is none-yet. Cover image file is named 'AnimagiC_2026_Hintergrund.jpg' but is the current live homepage background (no 2027-labelled wide image exists yet); the only 2027-branded images are a set of five narrow (1068x110) section banners, too thin to use as a cover.
